title: Create Grid With Exactly K Paths II
summary: Only k is supplied. Choose the grid dimensions yourself. Return equal-length strings of . (free) and # (blocked), with exactly k free-cell paths from top-left to bottom-right using only right/down moves. Return [] if no admissible grid exists. Any construction satisfying these conditions is accepted.
